Market today: The tech and chip sectors are feeling good, driven by fading AI software fears and Nvidia's massive revenue forecast. This momentum is directly impacting your concentrated book.

Your holdings: SOXL (-56.25%) is a deep concern, being a leveraged decay product. SMH (-13.08%) and QQQI (-3.33%) are also flagged for trimming. SPAL (-38.81%) is a brand-new, very volatile leveraged ETF. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on your leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) for further decay. Also, monitor the broader chip sector's reaction to Nvidia's news.

Bottom line: Prioritize managing risk in your leveraged positions while staying alert to continued AI-driven tech strength.
plays: Consider trimming SOXL to reduce exposure to its deep loss and leveraged decay.
Review SMH and QQQI for potential trims as flagged by your scanner.
Watch SPAL closely; as a new, leveraged ETF, its -38.81% loss on margin is amplified.
